new_value: Audited lichen_coap_format_ipv6 (coap_status.c:272) for stack safety. Verified against actual Zephyr net_addr_ntop (fetched pinned v3.7.0 + local 4.1.0): it ignores the size parameter and writes unbounded, max 45 chars + NUL = 46 = INET6_ADDRSTRLEN, so the existing guard buf_size >= LICHEN_CONFIG_ADDR_MAX_LEN (46, coap_config.h:35) is exactly sufficient and rejects smaller buffers with -ENOBUFS before any write; no partial writes possible. Audited all 9 callers: coap_msg.c:633/676/755 pass addr_str[LICHEN_MSG_ADDR_LEN=46], coap_status.c:379/388/465/532/544/560 pass ipv6_buf[LICHEN_CONFIG_ADDR_MAX_LEN=46], all via sizeof, all addr inputs are uint8_t[16] struct members; the single snprintf (prefix_buf[52], max content 50) is fully return-checked. ipv6_buf sizes already derive from the macro via sizeof per Kconfig-style config; no undersized caller found. Hardened: added BUILD_ASSERT(LICHEN_CONFIG_ADDR_MAX_LEN >= INET6_ADDRSTRLEN) in coap_status.c so a future shrink of the constant fails the build instead of silently enabling overflow (NET_IPV6_ADDR_LEN=40 deliberately NOT used; it excludes the v4-mapped tail). Corrected coap_status.h doc from 'recommend >=46' to the enforced minimum contract. Verification: clang -fsyntax-only on macOS against Zephyr 4.1 headers with real native_sim generated autoconf + real Kconfig coap defaults (MAX_NEIGHBORS/MAX_ROUTES=8, COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE=896): zero errors from this change; sole remaining diagnostics are the two documented pre-existing Mach-O section-specifier artifacts at LOG_MODULE_REGISTER/K_MUTEX_DEFINE (ELF-target Zephyr on Apple clang, pre-existing for any logging TU, same as bead f5uc). Negative test: shadowing the constant at 45 fires 'static assertion failed: 45 >= 46' as intended. cppcheck clean on the file. No commits made per task instructions.
